With Grass Wonder, El Condor Pasa, and 
Silence Suzuka all competing— Tokyo 
Racecourse buzzed with an extraordinary 
level of excitement.

Taiki Shuttle visits to watch the race 
again, accompanied by Reporter Otonashi.

With countless fans watching, the race 
began. Silence Suzuka seized the lead, 
accelerated further down the final 
stretch, and secured a front-running 
victory.

Her unique running style, something only 
she could pull off, was truly 
unforgettable to all who watched.
